# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Skia m154 engine update**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m154 while retaining the new Graphite and asynchronous pixel-read capabilities. It carries forward improved native package diagnostics, lifetime fixes, and Nano Server font support. Linux applications relying on implicit font fallback should review the breaking change below.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may choose a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify a family and style, or bundle a typeface, when deterministic font selection is required.

## Engine

- **Skia updated through milestone m154** — Updates the bundled renderer with the m152, m153, and m154 engine lines and their upstream stability fixes. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU bindings added** — Adds Graphite backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, alongside a Vulkan Silk.NET package for applications that use those integrations. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))
- **Asynchronous pixel reads added** — SKImage and SKSurface now expose backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels support. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native object lifetime issues corrected** — Fixes use-after-free paths for SKRegion span iteration and SKPixmap subsets, and releases pixel memory when raster image creation fails. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **Runtime-effect and HarfBuzz resources released correctly** — Resetting runtime-effect uniforms now disposes the previous buffer, while non-memory-backed streams are released after conversion to HarfBuzz blobs. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Hot-path allocations reduced** — Improves common data, text-tag, runtime-effect, and HarfBuzz shaping paths by removing avoidable copies, boxing, and allocations. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Platform

- **Native diagnostics and font support improved** — Apple symbol packages are produced during packing, Android symbols receive deterministic identities, and Nano Server gains FreeType font support. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843), [#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

Improves HarfBuzz shaping by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy and fixes stream ownership when creating blobs. Package documentation was also refreshed.
